correctness.rationale: Independently constructed the specified 12-vertex, 30-edge degree-five icosahedral graph and enumerated all 125 perfect matchings recursively. For each unordered pair, symmetric difference has one connected degree-two even alternating cycle exactly when a single legal length-4 or length-6 flip occurs; this yields 300 and 580 transition edges. Exhaustive BFS on the full 125-state graphs gives R4 components (120,1,1,1,1,1), main-component radius 5 and diameter 6; R6 connected with radius 3 and diameter 4. Exactly five R4 isolated matchings are the five R6 eccentricity-3 centers, and all others have eccentricity 4. Legal cycles need not be induced/facial. Exact finite exhaustion supplies proof for this one graph.
residual_risks: Finite graph-specific result only; does not imply analogous connectivity for all 5-regular or triangulated graphs.

evidence: Bonamy et al. analyze 4-cycle reachability/complexity and graph classes; Bošković analyzes cycle-length connectivity in decorated graph families.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Neither inspected theorem yields the detailed icosahedral length-six metric census, and the latter family assumptions do not automatically identify the icosahedron.

value.rationale: Exactly resolves a natural finite combinatorial-state reachability problem for the highly symmetric icosahedron: length-four flips have five frozen matchings, length-six flips connect everything and make those same states optimally central. The full metric and coincidence have intrinsic structural interest beyond merely re-counting the 125 matchings.
residual_risks: The conclusion is an exact self-contained finite finding; no broader family theorem or induced/facial-cycle result is asserted.

final_claim: For perfect matchings of the icosahedron, 4-flip graph has 300 edges and components (120,1^5); 6-flip graph has 580 edges, radius 3 and diameter 4, with the five 4-flip isolated matchings exactly the 6-flip centers.
limitations: Chords of legal alternating cycles allowed; not facial resonance.
The 125 matching count is credited prior work.
